data.title: 阿尔法 · 圣域彩窗下的月华回眸
data.description: 高耸幽寂的大理石圣殿回廊内，苍蓝月光穿过哥特彩绘玻璃窗笔直射下，纯白露背长裙的阿尔法单手抚胸驻足回眸。
data.location: towering ancient marble cathedral nave with arched stained glass windows
data.action: standing paused beneath a dramatic moonbeam shaft, one slender hand resting on collarbone, glancing back over shoulder with tender fond gaze
data.lighting: 高窗垂直月华光束与冷调漫反射
data.promptProse: Alpha stands within a shaft of cool moonlight inside an ancient cathedral, turning back with a tender glance in her elegant white backless dress.
data.animaCaption: A vertical moonlight beam touches her white gown as she looks back warmly.
